initial_account: cash only; initialized once per capital and execution model
sizing: same causal factor weights; each account sizes from its own current NAV and actual inventory
debug_factor: 20-session unadjusted price momentum; top 15 equal weights; not an accepted company factor
ordinary_residual: expires that day; actual positions, cash, liabilities and entitlements persist
exceptional_residual: positive suspension or official directional limit with fresh raw zero opposing depth; cancelled at next rebalance
financing: sufficient funding; debt fully recorded; explicitly zero engineering interest
return_basis: daily actual net assets divided by the unique initial capital; total return is final/initial-1
corporate_actions: point-in-time market-known versions and independently reconciled entitlements; gross cash dividends, no individual tax certification
missing_data: unknown gaps stop the continuous run; no excluded middle dates, no zero-liquidity substitution
historical_data: archived overwriteable source; not certified production database PIT
order_count_meaning: incomplete_eod_orders counts uncompleted tasks on their submission day; incomplete_orders counts final residuals of all historical parents, not live orders at period end
corporate_action_coverage_scope: announcement_window metadata plus complete exports of listed market-visible versions; not certification of every economic event family
window_selection_reason: contiguous existing evidence-supported stage window; not a replacement claim for the blocked July-September study
prepared_cache_limit_role: engineering memory guard; not a financial or capacity parameter

original_window_blockers.corporate_action_lifecycle_coverage: uncovered natural-date ranges remain in July and September; see original input quality
